subject: Mutual rollout plan & environment gating for NovaCare evaluation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacare.com>, Victor Chen <victor.chen@novacare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual rollout plan & environment gating for NovaCare evaluation
Attachments: MAP_NovaCare_v1.3.pdf (map draft), nova-allowlist.csv (sample CIDRs)

Hi Elena / Victor,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, I put together a concise mutual rollout plan and the environment gating checklist so we can get you into a production-like eval quickly. I attached a short MAP draft (MAP_NovaCare_v1.3.pdf) and a sample allowlist CSV that contains the CIDR seeds we typically ask for. High level asks: 

- Org & accounts: add the Redwood service account (see MAP doc) to your org with Viewer + VPC peering permissions; we will provision ephemeral API keys scoped to the eval tenant.
- API keys: Redwood will create scoped, time-bound eval keys (ephemeral). We need a single service account email and preferred TTL (~7 days) to seed the workflow.
- IP safelist: Please confirm the CIDR blocks in nova-allowlist.csv. We can accept a minimal /24 range to reduce surface area.
- VPC peering: Provide the AWS account ID(s) and desired peering window (date/time in UTC). We prefer an early-morning maintenance window (US-PST) to reduce impact.
- Security gating: NovaCare Security to provide SOC2 attestation or a signed AOC, plus any required firewall templates.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
1) Today/T+1: Agree MAP tasks and owners
2) T+2: Redwood prepares ephemeral key flow + staging environment
3) T+4: Network peering + allowlist applied (test window)
4) T+6: Smoke tests and evaluation kickoff

Can you confirm owners for org invite, network contact, and security contact? Once confirmed we’ll drop this MAP into HubSpot (deal RDW-5421) and send a DocuSign for the standard eval terms.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

---

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacare.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Chen <victor.chen@novacare.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual rollout plan & environment gating for NovaCare evaluation
Attachments: nova-peering-reqs.pdf (network team template)

Thanks, Priyom — this looks good and exactly the level of detail we need. Quick notes from our side: 

- Security: I looped in NovaCare Security (security@novacare.com). They require a SOC2 Type II report or equivalent AOC for any hosted service. We can share ours once provided.
- Network: attached the peering requirements doc; our network team needs the exact VPC ID and the account ID of the peer. They prefer peering on Wed 2025-06-11 between 02:00-05:00 UTC.
- Org invite: I’ll send an org invite to the service account you list, but please confirm the email we should use.

I’ll confirm owners by EOD. If you can draft the ephemeral key flow and a short runbook for the peering window that would speed things up.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Platform Engineering — NovaCare

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual rollout plan & environment gating for NovaCare evaluation

Thanks — quick technical sync from Redwood infra: 

- Ephemeral keys: We’ll generate scoped keys using our eval tenant flow. Recommend TTL=7 days with automated rotation; we’ll deliver a key-seed and an expiration table in the runbook.
- Service account: Use eval-service@redwood-eval.svc (we can accept a different email if NovaCare org policy requires).
- VPC peering specifics: We need peer account ID (AWS) and a desired peering CIDR mapping. For minimal blast radius, we suggest creating a dedicated peering VPC in your account for the eval (we will only route required subnets).
- Firewall template: attaching a short example in the runbook — will prepare and link to Drive.
- Dedicated/private option: If NovaCare prefers, we can spin up the eval on a Redwood Dedicated node (isolated GPU pool) — this is optional but reduces compliance overhead.

Proposed action items from Redwood (I’ll own these):
1) Draft ephemeral key runbook + sample rotation script (today)
2) Prepare peering change steps + rollback (today)
3) Standup staging env with test data (T+2)
4) Support peering window (2025-06-11 02:00-05:00 UTC)

I’ll share the runbook link here once ready.

-karthik

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novacare.com>, Victor Chen <victor.chen@novacare.com>

Elena — appreciate the quick feedback and the peering window. Per Karthik’s note, we’ll proceed with the ephemeral-key flow (TTL=7d) and schedule the peering for the requested window (2025-06-11 02:00-05:00 UTC).

Next steps for you (please confirm owners):
- Org invite: confirm the service account email to invite (suggested: eval-service@redwood-eval.svc)
- Network owner: confirm contact for peering (name + email) and your exact VPC ID and Account ID
- Security owner: confirm the security contact who will accept the SOC2/AOC or coordinate an exception

I pushed the MAP into HubSpot (see deal RDW-5421) and created a DocuSign envelope for the eval terms — link below. I attached the standard eval terms for review (redwood-eval-terms.docx). If the peering window works we’ll proceed with the staging smoke test the same day.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/embedded?env=RDW-5421
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if that helps coordinate the peering window.

Priyom
